answer: In PoA, every identity locks bonded collateral in escrow, making equivocation an economic liability. If k identities coordinate conflicting attestations, correlated evidence triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), rather than k independent fines. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to the controlling operator’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation reduces residual collateral value. Thus a whisper, lantern, or voyage of coordination cannot make a sybil swarm cheaper than honest participation.
